title: Clopen rank stratum homology presentation
statement: In the clopen rank-stratum situation of lem-sc-clopen-rank-strata-homology-lift, for K and n there exists an isomorphism e from the n-th homology of K placed in degree n to K whose induced map under the canonical single-complex homology identification is the identity.

source.place: expanded proof of lem-sc-clopen-rank-strata-homology-lift, idempotent splitting and truncation

proof.text: Split K by the characteristic idempotent of the rank-n clopen stratum. The complementary summand has zero homology in every degree by the hypotheses on the other strata, while the image summand has only its n-th homology. Canonical truncation identifies this summand with the n-th homology placed in degree n; composing with the inclusion gives e, and naturality gives the identity equation.

proof_origin.note: Stage-3 decomposition of the geometric idempotent/truncation argument.
